stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: The closed bridge compelled us to take another route.
items.sentenceZh: 桥梁封闭迫使我们改走另一条路。
items.scene: A hiking group reaches a clearly closed small bridge over a stream and must follow a safe alternative path around it, with a visible route fork. Show external constraint causing changed action, no danger or warning text.
items.altText: 小桥封闭，徒步者不得不改走另一条安全路径。

items.sentenceEn: Encryption protected the message in transit.
items.sentenceZh: 加密保护了传输中的消息。
items.scene: A sender's clear pictorial message enters a locked transformation device, travels as an unreadable pattern inside a sealed channel, and is restored only at an authorized receiver's matching key. Show transformation and privacy, not mere password entry; no text.
items.altText: 可读消息经加密变成不可读图案，到授权接收端后还原。

items.sentenceEn: She changed the configuration to save energy.
items.sentenceZh: 她调整配置以节约能源。
items.scene: Technician adjusts a small set of unlabeled sliders and switches on an equipment control panel; nearby device changes from high-energy glow to efficient mode, with a simple gauge falling. Emphasize set-up choices, not physical repair; no writing.
items.altText: 技术员调整设备设置，使能耗下降。

items.sentenceEn: The sensor's sensitivity detected a tiny change in light.
items.sentenceZh: 传感器的灵敏度使它察觉到微小的光线变化。
items.scene: Close educational view of a light sensor registering a barely changing beam of light through a tiny movement on a pictorial gauge, while a nearby less sensitive sensor stays still. Accurate instrument relationship, no numbers or text.
items.altText: 高灵敏度传感器察觉到微弱的光线变化。

items.sentenceEn: HTTP carried the browser's request to the server.
items.sentenceZh: HTTP 将浏览器请求传给服务器。
items.scene: A web browser on a laptop sends a page-request packet along one arrow to a server; server returns a page made of picture tiles along a second arrow. Clearly request-response protocol, no locks, URL text, code or labels.
items.altText: 浏览器向服务器发送网页请求，服务器再返回页面内容。

items.sentenceEn: Someday she hopes to play on a big stage.
items.sentenceZh: 她希望有朝一日能登上大舞台。
items.scene: At home in a contemporary Chinese city, a young adult violinist practices by a window; a soft translucent future vignette shows her performing on a larger stage. Present hope versus future possibility, no guarantee or text.
items.altText: 中国城市里，年轻小提琴手练习并憧憬有朝一日登台。

items.sentenceEn: The photo caught the instant the ball hit the water.
items.sentenceZh: 照片捕捉到球触水的一瞬间。
items.scene: Single clear freeze-frame of a small ball just touching the surface of a pond, with first tiny ring and upward droplets only beginning; nearby photographer captures that exact fleeting moment. Not a long sequence or splash aftermath.
items.altText: 小球刚触及水面的瞬间，水珠才开始跃起。

items.sentenceEn: The app stored the settings as JSON.
items.sentenceZh: 应用把设置保存为 JSON 格式。
items.scene: A software data card uses clean nested brace-shaped frames enclosing several orderly paired pictogram-and-color-value tiles, including one nested group; the same structure feeds an app. Convey JSON's hierarchical key-value data format without literal characters, digits or code.
items.altText: 应用把设置整理成带嵌套层级的键值数据结构。

items.sentenceEn: The council voted to abolish the old entry fee.
items.sentenceZh: 议会投票废除了旧的入场费。
items.scene: Fictional community garden entrance shown before and after a council decision: first visitors hand over a coin at gate, then the coin collection box is removed and people enter freely; council members in inset vote calmly. No real jurisdiction symbols or words.
items.altText: 社区决议取消旧入场费后，居民无需付款即可进入花园。

items.sentenceEn: The young dancer made her debut on stage.
items.sentenceZh: 年轻舞者首次登台亮相。
items.scene: At a contemporary Chinese community theater, a young adult dancer steps into spotlight for her first public performance while backstage mentor watches encouragingly and audience applauds. Emphasize first entrance and nervous excitement, no signs or text.
items.altText: 中国社区剧场里，一名年轻舞者首次登台表演。

items.sentenceEn: His plan to move the sofa with a spoon was absurd.
items.sentenceZh: 他想用勺子搬动沙发的计划十分荒谬。
items.scene: In a living room, an adult earnestly presents a tiny spoon beside a very heavy sofa as his proposed moving tool; two friends react with incredulous expressions and a proper hand truck sits nearby. Comically impossible mismatch, no injury or text.
items.altText: 有人竟想用小勺子搬沙发，朋友们觉得荒谬。

items.sentenceEn: The mayor proclaimed the festival open.
items.sentenceZh: 市长宣布节庆活动开幕。
items.scene: A fictional town mayor speaks clearly into a microphone at an outdoor festival opening, crowd applauds and stalls begin welcoming visitors. Make public formal announcement focal, no banners with words, flags or real seals.
items.altText: 市长在群众面前正式宣布节庆开幕。

items.sentenceEn: She enrolled at an art academy.
items.sentenceZh: 她进入一所艺术学院学习。
items.scene: A contemporary Chinese art academy campus with studio classrooms, easels, sculpture workspaces and students carrying portfolios, one new student arriving at entrance with supplies. Show educational institution, not a military academy; no sign text.
items.altText: 中国艺术学院校园里，新生带着画具走向工作室。

items.sentenceEn: The song reached listeners worldwide.
items.sentenceZh: 这首歌传到了世界各地的听众耳中。
items.scene: A globe centered in image with varied people in several distant regions listening to music on simple devices, elegant sound-wave paths crossing continents. No flags, country stereotypes, labels or text.
items.altText: 同一首歌通过网络传到全球各地的听众耳中。

items.sentenceEn: She accidentally knocked over the cup.
items.sentenceZh: 她不小心碰倒了杯子。
items.scene: At a contemporary Chinese tea shop, a customer turns and unintentionally nudges a small cup with her elbow; tea spills onto table, she looks surprised and apologetic while another person reaches for a cloth. No harm, no writing.
items.altText: 中国茶馆里，顾客不小心碰倒茶杯，茶水洒在桌上。

items.sentenceEn: We went on a hike through the hills.
items.sentenceZh: 我们沿山丘步道去远足。
items.scene: A small group of adults hikes on a marked safe trail through green hills in China, carrying daypacks and enjoying the view; natural walking motion, not mountaineering or a price hike. No trail-sign writing.
items.altText: 中国山丘步道上，几位徒步者背着轻便背包远足。

items.sentenceEn: The guesthouse provided comfortable accommodation.
items.sentenceZh: 这家客栈提供舒适的住宿。
items.scene: In a contemporary Chinese small-town guesthouse, a traveler enters a clean cozy room with made bed, window and luggage stand; host offers a key at doorway. Focus on place to stay, not compromise or accessibility adaptation.
items.altText: 中国小城客栈为旅客提供整洁舒适的住处。

items.sentenceEn: A helmet is required at the worksite.
items.sentenceZh: 工地上必须佩戴安全帽。
items.scene: At a safe construction-site entrance, a worker stops before gate to put on a protective helmet handed over by safety supervisor; everyone inside wears one. Requirement apparent from consistent rule, no written sign or logos.
items.altText: 进入工地前，工人必须戴上安全帽。

items.sentenceEn: The forecast called for rain, so we dressed accordingly.
items.sentenceZh: 天气预报说会下雨，因此我们穿上相应的雨具。
items.scene: In one coherent scene, dark rain clouds gather outside window while two adults choose waterproof coats and boots before leaving; their clothing responds to the expected weather. No written forecast screen.
items.altText: 预见下雨，两人相应地穿上雨衣和雨靴。

items.sentenceEn: The confrontation ended when both sides agreed to talk.
items.sentenceZh: 双方同意交谈后，对抗结束了。
items.scene: At a fictional neighborhood meeting, two groups initially stand opposite each other tensely across a table; a mediator invites both to sit and discuss, with softened expressions. Use subtle before-to-after visual transition, no violence, slogans or text.
items.altText: 原本对立的两方在调解下坐下来交谈。
